title: OOP1new and Libre 2 with Sync followers
body:
### Subject of the issue
On a non NFC master phone (KingKong Mini 2), when using a Libre 2 EU with OOP1new (fa218ef 2019-11-22) , versions above https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2022.03.26 do not allow followers to receive data.
Versions above https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.10.13 start showing NFC block errors in master and follower.

### Environment
- Master above 2022.03.26
- Master KingKong Mini 2, NSClient
- Bubble bridge
- All followers (various Android versions from 6 to 12) in Sync follower
- Master using OOP1 enabled

### Expected behavior
Followers should display BG.

### Actual behavior
Libre blocks are received but ignored.

### Screenshots
Screenshots won't add value, what's the best way to share some logs?
